SAE models and checkpoints

Author-published sparse dictionaries for language, vision and multimodal backbones, with our own model information pages and direct checkpoint downloads. Select a dictionary by its exact source model, hook and input conventions; raw author weights require conversion before native model-bound use.

Snapshot: 2026-10-19. 9660 unique SAE checkpoints; five separately labeled vision backbones. Alias names for the same checkpoint are merged. Unreported fields remain unspecified.
